correctness.rationale: Energy Riesz representation plus the integrated resistance identity give the exact Green diagonal; cactus block resistance decomposition yields the explicit potentials and J_B formulas. Bridge strict convexity, cycle strict concavity and exclusion of cut vertices establish an exhaustive candidate set with no unproved optimization step. Direct arithmetic in the non-antipodal example yields K=1777/1500. The exact-rational separately implemented finite-element checker compares 264 sampled Green values across eight cactus graphs; this is corroboration, not an all-case proof.

value.rationale: The theorem covers arbitrary-length metric cactus graphs of unrestricted finite size, computes the precise sharp Sobolev constant and *all* norming evaluation locations with finitely many quadratic candidates, and includes a unique global maximizer not located at a cycle antipode. This fills a structural gap between exact special-family formulas and general electrical resistance foundations, and gives a direct observation-site-selection invariant.
